Package.Name: OnvifDoods
Package.Author: Elie Bertret
Package.Description: Watches ONVIF cameras for motion and runs a snapshot through a DOODS2 object-detection server, publishing what it finds as Telemetry

Setting.name: Cameras
Setting.description: ONVIF cameras to watch - Name, OnvifUri, Username, Password, optional ProfileToken, RtspUrl, EnableMotionEvents, MinSecondsBetweenDetections and PollingIntervalSeconds per entry. Leave RtspUrl empty to grab the detection frame via the camera's own ONVIF snapshot service, or set it to capture via RTSP/ffmpeg instead for a camera whose ONVIF snapshot doesn't work. Set EnableMotionEvents to false for a camera confirmed to never fire ONVIF motion events, and use PollingIntervalSeconds as the only trigger instead.

Setting.name: DoodsUrl
Setting.description: Base URL of the DOODS2 server (https://github.com/snowzach/doods2), no trailing path.

Setting.name: DoodsDetectorName
Setting.description: DOODS2 detector to use - matches whatever is configured on the DOODS2 server's own doods.conf.yaml.

Setting.name: Labels
Setting.description: Object labels to detect and their minimum confidence (0-100), passed straight through to DOODS2's own detect request field.
